root_cause.explanation: The frozen validator computes devtree - virt_base + phys_base with Python integers, which goes negative here. The u64 result is 0x80470c000, which m1n1 itself used: startup.c:197 (u64 C arithmetic) and pinned proxyutils.py:269/277 (& 0xffffffffffffffff). The worker log shows m1n1 then parsed that ADT (model, target, 'pmgr: initialized, 268 devices').
root_cause.recurrence: The raw boot_args from the four earlier successful runs had virt_base 0xa078000 / 0xc078000 / 0x10078000 (varying in 32 MiB steps) with the same phys_base, so none wrapped. A wrapping virt_base can occur on any boot; the fix is required, not a one-off.
